name: ogp-config-and-flags
description: Catalog of every configuration axis in Open Garden Planner: QSettings keys (AppSettings), UI-state persistence (UiStateStore), environment variables (.env / OGP_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY / QT_QPA_PLATFORM / PYTHONUTF8), project-file version + per-plan settings, hidden-feature toggles in code, tooling config (pyproject/ruff/mypy/pytest/pins/ogp.spec), and CI knobs. Load this when: adding or changing a setting or flag; wondering what a settings key does or what its default is; configuring environment variables or .env; touching the Preferences dialog; deciding whether a change needs a FILE_VERSION bump; or a feature seems mysteriously disabled (hidden panel, missing API key, default-off snap mode). Includes the "how to add a setting" checklist.
